observations_and_questions.classification: bounded current continuation of q610 frame question; no new unique finding
observations_and_questions.trace: The public record_extremity_armor validates the design through shape, whose selected variants are mitten, sabaton and leather boot. PartRecipe routes chart/coordinate shells to code that selects frames via get(index).ok_or(InvalidSurface); if that lookup is reached with a missing referenced frame, it produces a typed error rather than indexing panic. The mitten thumb chart names frame 1; the inspected DeviceWearer call supplies hand and thumb buffers. The selected sabaton and boot callers supply one frame and inspected footwear toe/boot coordinate shells name frame 0. The admitted mitten finger count is 2–6 and sabaton count 3–8, protecting the observed per-lame division on those validated paths.
observations_and_questions.limits: The frame list check alone does not validate buffer byte lengths, frame finiteness or semantic side/fit. Allocation, uploads and earlier shell recording occur before a later missing-frame lookup; batch submission/error-handling behavior was not traced. Other coordinate/chart shells, callers, native code, GPU and device failures remain open. No device, shader, mesh, test or probe ran. q610 and 774 ADDITIONAL-064 remain historical connected contracts, not newly counted duplicates.

observations_and_questions.classification: bounded guard/aggregate confirmation, previously assessed; no new finding
observations_and_questions.trace: JointCupDesign validates both coverage ranges and any distal extension, then rejects an extension on RaisedCop. Its parent LimbArmorDesign separately checks construction-dependent wing, dome/length and other controls plus gauge, and the inspected limb shape calls this parent before joint_cup. Extension validation allows 1–4 lames; the generator handles one explicitly before dividing by lames-1 for the multi-lame case. The inspected studio mode transition clears extension on selecting RaisedCop and caps wing to the new construction range.
observations_and_questions.limits: Raw public fields and serde precede these gates; validate_construction by itself is deliberately narrower than parent validation. This does not establish all producer paths, real mesh geometry, fitting frames, intersections or native behavior. An otherwise-valid optional absence is supported. Prior 774 ADDITIONAL-066 and ASSESSMENT-LIMB-METAL-95E already record the same guard/count family; q1814/q1815 remain connected questions.

observations_and_questions.classification: source-backed mode/ownership question; no asserted defect
observations_and_questions.trace: The parent retains and validates medial/lateral wrap fields in both constructions. The inspected shader source consumes them in raised_point, while wrapped_point derives its angle from its own fixed constants and wing; the studio exposes wrap controls in RaisedCop and retains values when switching to Wrapped. The values can therefore remain available when returning to the raised mode.
observations_and_questions.limits: The selected expression is source text only; no shader compiled or geometry evaluated. The intended ownership of dormant mode-specific controls and whether all representations should retain these values is a design policy question, not proof of wrong geometry or a new accepted unique finding. Do not require removing state or a compatibility path on this evidence.

nonfindings: Shape dispatch deliberately rejects non-extremity LimbArmorDesign variants with InvalidSurface after validation; this alone does not invalidate supported limb designs.
Optional extension on Wrapped and absence on RaisedCop are meaningful modes; an orientation retained when no fluting exists is not automatically an invalid state.
The inspected editor transition enforces the construction/wing relation; it is not a proof every authored caller validates.
Prior 059 and 774 evidence cannot be credited as an independent current assigned read or later complete lens.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Typed designs enter validated shape dispatch, then recipe and bounded frame consumers; supported frame/content producers and every other path remain open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: LimbArmorDesign and construction/orientation enums own meaningful variants; PlateGauge and unit types remain context-specific rather than universal wrappers.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Parent validates fluting, joint construction, ranges and gauge before selected shape; actual native frame content remains outside this gate.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: The selected frame list accesses are checked and admitted lame counts prevent observed zero division. Buffer sizes, late errors and device behavior remain open.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: RaisedCop with extension is rejected and the editor transition removes it; wing bounds depend on construction. The full cross-field shape/fitting contract is not thereby proven.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Joint cup owns wrap/wing semantics and extension has its own validator; canonical frame-buffer ownership remains a connected open question.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Construction-dependent bounds plus retained dormant wraps have distinct possible roles; no independent conflicting source of truth established.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: Wing up to 2000 and other >1000 Permille values are shape scales, not automatically invalid normalized probabilities.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: Wrapped and RaisedCop encode separate construction; optional extension and dormant controls carry deliberate policy, with representation choice unresolved.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Enums/DTOs derive applicable serde and standard traits; invariant-bearing validation and other derivation opportunities are outside this bounded proof.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: chart_kernel receives shader source strings; q2691 rejects a semantic-ID suspicion in its scoped native boundary, not a global strings verdict.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Count limits, distinct wing ranges, 0.004m clearance and mode constants are examined only in their actual operations; no broad value rewrite justified.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Future remedies must preserve valid shape/optional modes and deliberate typed rejection; no repairs or execution evidence exists.
